notable_claims: Spamming is a human problem solvable at the human level rather than the technical Usenet level.
Mass reporting to postmasters is an effective way to force providers to discipline spamming users.
classification.summary: A user advocates for a grassroots campaign to combat Usenet spam by flooding originating postmasters with complaints. The author argues that spam is a human behavioral problem rather than a technical one and urges users to demand disciplinary action against offenders.
classification.title: Stamp out SPAMMING in our lifetimes!
